parameters.content:
## Medusa Order → Thinkific Enrollment

**Trigger:** POST /webhook/medusa-order-complete
Fired by order-placed.ts subscriber when the order contains course products.

**Required env vars in n8n container:**
- THINKIFIC_API_KEY (Bearer token, write:all scope)
- RESEND_API_KEY
- N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET (shared secret for signature verification)
- SENTRY_DSN / SENTRY_DSN_WEB / SENTRY_DSN_MEDUSA (any of these — optional)

**Thinkific subdomain:** ravenallinstitute-9629
**Thinkific API base:** https://api.thinkific.com/api/public/v1
**Thinkific admin:** https://ravenallinstitute-9629.thinkific.com

**What this workflow does:**
1. Verifies webhook secret header
2. Extracts customer + course IDs from order line item product.metadata.thinkific_course_id
3. Exits cleanly if no course items found (non-course order)
4. Finds or creates Thinkific user by email
5. Enrolls user in each course (isolated — one failure does not abort others)
6. Sends customer confirmation email via Resend
7. Sends admin alert email for any enrollment failures

**Error policy:**
Fatal (user create/find) → admin alert → stop.
Partial (per-course) → continue other courses → customer email → admin alert for failures.
Order is NEVER blocked.
